name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsports was somewhat accidental, starting with a small catering business that landed a contract with a local racing team. He quickly discovered a passion for the high-energy environment and the dedication of everyone involved. Over the years, he honed his skills in managing complex logistics and ensuring top-quality meals for demanding drivers and crew members.

At Cadillac Racing, Ricardo prides himself on providing a comforting and familiar culinary experience amidst the chaos of race weekends. He believes that proper nutrition and a touch of home are essential for maintaining peak performance and morale. His approach is detail-oriented, and he's known for his ability to source the freshest ingredients, even in remote locations. What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to creating a positive and nurturing atmosphere around the dining table, a welcome respite from the pressures of the track.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stout man with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on using only Spanish olive oil, even when alternatives are readily available.
Secretly critiques the chefs at Michelin-starred restaurants when traveling.
Always carries a small, worn copy of a classic Spanish cookbook.
